title: Matrix Puzzle
statement: For n×n matrices a, b (n ≤ 1000), q ≤ 2·10^4 operations add x to a submatrix of a or ask whether a submatrix of b−a splits as h_i + w_j. That holds iff every adjacent 2×2 mixed difference vanishes, so rectangle adds become four point updates of a 2D difference array and queries count nonzero cells with a 2D Fenwick tree, or per-row prefix counts since q is small.
